test_title: PYST 211: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 1st Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A is the father of D. C and D are brothers. G is the mother of B, and C is the brother of B. How is G related to A?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbol: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba4d5ba639f20215566bc8ee64138f39d27f59206fadf8e2dbd9fc1240d5cb4e.png] 

Family Tree :-

1) A is the father of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d459ac2bc25632df04190cde0e9ebb63a5d5aef85d7ab0065709a96477238cd4.png] 

2) C and D are brothers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b581a11fe4147b0c5e8388030985d04001933124123c950b7e4585c3d7c63a71.png] 

3) C is the brother of B and G is the mother of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/111a28259a3db5375f0cc30d667895124b164be84f31342b5d451c32721e2366.png] 

∴ Here, G is the wife of A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Wife".**
